judgment.reason: p16 gives ivory hat ∨ ivory badge. If hat, p18 gives scarlet ribbon; if badge, p6 gives scarlet ribbon. Either disjunct yields scarlet ribbon, and p4 then yields ivory coat. So by disjunction elimination, Ada wears an ivory coat is provable, making the negation false. The argument incorrectly treated the disjunction as inert, missing that both disjuncts independently lead to the same conclusion.
